content: Windows audio capture (cpal/wasapi): WASAPI loopback = build an INPUT stream on a RENDER endpoint in cpal — no separate loopback API; use for capturing system audio, NOT needed for dictation which needs the microphone (default capture). cpal issue #1200: AUTOCONVERTPCM produces SILENT input streams on Windows 11 24H2 Communications-class endpoints (default communications device captured at -85dB peak = broken); must use Console-class or raw/default PCM instead of autoconvert. The  crate (docs.rs) offers get_default_device and Direction::Capture. Loopback captures whatever plays — wrong choice for dictation.
